title: Makaranta da aiki
description: Ten short, simple stories about school and work in Hausaland: a science test, a doctor on night duty, a metalworker, a school election, a food business, a court, Independence Day, a boatman, a writer and a museum guide.

lessons.title: Auwalu da kimiyya
lessons.summary: Auwalu, a student in Zaria, finds science hard until his teacher reads a page about light with him, and the next day he answers all ten questions.
lessons.text:
Auwalu ɗalibi ne a wata makaranta a Zaria. Yana son karatu sosai, amma yana ganin kimiyya tana da wuya. Malam Sagir shi ne malaminsu na kimiyya.

Wata rana Malam Sagir ya ce wa ɗalibansa, "Gobe za ku amsa tambayoyi goma a kan kimiyya."

Auwalu ya ji tsoro. "Gobe?" ya ce. Bayan makaranta, ya je wajen malaminsa.

"Malam, kimiyya tana da wuya a wurina," ya ce. "Ina karanta littafin kimiyya, amma ban fahimta ba."

Malam Sagir ya ce, "Kimiyya ba ta da wuya. Idan ka fahimta, za ka ga tana da sauƙi. Zo mu karanta tare."

Malamin ya buɗe littafin, sai suka karanta wani shafi tare. Shafin yana magana game da haske. "Haske yana zuwa daga rana," Malam Sagir ya ce. "Idan babu haske, ba za mu ga komai ba."

"Yanzu na fahimta!" Auwalu ya ce. "Wannan ba shi da wuya!"

"To, ka koma gida, ka karanta sauran littafin har sai ka gama," malamin ya ce.

Da Auwalu ya isa gida, ya ci abinci, sannan ya fara karatu. Ya karanta sauran littafin har ya gama.

Da rana ta fito, Auwalu ya tafi makaranta. Da ya isa makaranta, Malam Sagir ya ba ɗalibai tambayoyi goma. Auwalu ya karanta tambayoyin, sai ya ga cewa suna da sauƙi. Ya amsa dukka goma, kuma shi ne ya fara gama aikin.

Bayan kwana biyu, Malam Sagir ya ba ɗalibai sakamakonsu. Auwalu ya samu goma cikin goma.

"Ka ga?" malaminsa ya ce masa. "Kimiyya tana da sauƙi idan ka fahimta."

Tambayoyi:
Auwalu ɗalibi ne a ina?
Ɗalibi ne a wata makaranta a Zaria.
Wane ne malamin kimiyya?
Malam Sagir ne malamin kimiyya.
Me ya sa Auwalu ya je wajen malaminsa?
Domin yana ganin kimiyya tana da wuya.
Shafin yana magana game da me?
Yana magana game da haske.
Me Auwalu ya samu?
Ya samu goma cikin goma.

lessons.title: Likita Maimuna
lessons.summary: Maimuna, a doctor in Kano, works fast through the night when a young wife bleeds during her first birth, and the worried husband becomes father of a baby boy.
lessons.text:
Maimuna likita ce a Kano. Tana aiki a wani babban asibiti. Aikinta shi ne ta taimaka wa mata a lokacin haihuwa.

Wata rana da dare, wani mutum ya zo asibitin da sauri. Sunansa Kamilu. Matarsa Asma'u tana tare da shi, kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi.

"Likita, ki taimaka mana!" Kamilu ya ce. "Wannan ne karo na farko da za mu samu ɗa."

"Kada ka ji tsoro," Likita Maimuna ta ce. "Za mu taimaka mata."

Ta kai Asma'u wani ɗaki. Kamilu ya zauna a waje, kuma yana cikin damuwa sosai. A kusa da shi akwai wani tsoho mara lafiya.

Tsohon ya ce masa, "Me ya sa kake cikin damuwa haka?"

"Matata tana haihuwa," Kamilu ya ce. "Wannan ne karo na farko."

"Kada ka yi damuwa," tsohon mara lafiya ya ce. "Likita Maimuna likita ce mai kyau."

A cikin ɗakin, Likita Maimuna ta ga jini da yawa yana fita daga jikin Asma'u. Ta yi aiki da sauri. Ta kira wasu likitoci biyu, sai suka zo da sauri. Suka yi wa Asma'u ƙarin jini.

Kamilu ya ga likitocin suna gudu zuwa ɗakin. Damuwarsa ta ƙara girma. "Allah, kada matata ta mutu," ya ce.

Bayan wani lokaci, Likita Maimuna ta fito daga ɗakin. "Kada ka ji tsoro," ta ce wa Kamilu. "Matarka tana lafiya, kuma Allah ya ba ku ɗa namiji."

"Ɗa namiji!" Kamilu ya ce. Ya yi farin ciki sosai.

Asma'u ta ce wa mijinta, "Ka ga ɗanka namiji?" Mijinta ya ɗauki ɗan a hannunsa.

Bayan haka, Likita Maimuna ta je wajen tsohon mara lafiya. "Yanzu lokacinka ne," ta ce masa.

Tambayoyi:
Maimuna tana aiki a ina?
Tana aiki a wani babban asibiti a Kano.
Wane ne mijin Asma'u?
Kamilu ne mijin Asma'u.
Me ya sa Kamilu yake cikin damuwa?
Domin matarsa tana haihuwa, kuma karo na farko ne.
Me Allah ya ba Kamilu da Asma'u?
Allah ya ba su ɗa namiji.

lessons.title: Ƙofar ƙarfe
lessons.summary: Dahiru, a skilled metalworker in Kaduna, lowers his price and makes a beautiful red iron gate for Ummi in six days, and more customers follow.
lessons.text:
Dahiru yana aikin ƙarfe a Kaduna. Yana yin ƙofofin ƙarfe domin gidaje. Yana da fasaha sosai, kuma yana da ma'aikata tara. Mutane suna son aikinsa, saboda ƙofofinsa suna da kyau.

Wata rana wata mata mai suna Ummi ta zo wurinsa. "Ina son sabuwar ƙofa domin gidana," ta ce. "Ina son kyakkyawar ƙofar ƙarfe mai launin ja."

"Zan yi kyakkyawar ƙofa mai launin ja," Dahiru ya ce.

"Nawa ne kuɗinta?" Ummi ta ce.

"Dubu ɗari biyu," Dahiru ya ce.

"Dubu ɗari biyu? Kuɗin sun yi yawa. Ka rage min, don Allah."

Dahiru ya yi tunani. "To, na rage," ya ce. "Ki biya dubu ɗari ɗaya."

"Nawa ka rage?" Ummi ta ce.

"Na rage dubu ɗari ɗaya," Dahiru ya ce.

Ummi ta yi farin ciki. "Kwana nawa za ka yi?" ta ce.

"Kwana shida," Dahiru ya ce. "Ki dawo bayan kwana shida."

Dahiru da ma'aikatansa tara sun fara aiki. Sun yanke ƙarfe, kuma sun haɗa shi. Dahiru yana da fasaha, saboda haka ya yi zane mai kyau a jikin ƙofar. Sannan suka yi mata launin ja.

Bayan kwana shida, Ummi ta dawo. Ta ga ƙofar, sai ta yi mamaki. "Wannan ƙofa kyakkyawa ce!" ta ce. "Launin ja yana da kyau sosai."

Ta ba Dahiru dubu ɗari ɗaya, sannan ta kai ƙofar zuwa gidanta.

Bayan mako biyu, wasu mutane uku sun zo wajen Dahiru. Sun ga ƙofar Ummi, kuma suna son ƙofofi irin ta Ummi. Yanzu Dahiru da ma'aikatansa tara suna yin ƙofofi shida a kowane mako.

Tambayoyi:
Dahiru yana da ma'aikata nawa?
Yana da ma'aikata tara.
Wace ƙofa Ummi take so?
Tana son kyakkyawar ƙofar ƙarfe mai launin ja.
Nawa Ummi ta biya?
Ta biya dubu ɗari ɗaya.
Kwana nawa Dahiru ya yi?
Ya yi kwana shida.
Ƙofofi nawa Dahiru yake yi a kowane mako yanzu?
Yana yin ƙofofi shida a kowane mako.

lessons.title: Zaɓen makaranta
lessons.summary: At a girls' school in Katsina, Rashida and Kaltume stand for head girl; Kaltume wins on the promise of working together, and Rashida joins her.
lessons.text:
A wata makarantar 'yan mata a Katsina, kowace shekara ɗalibai suna zaɓen shugabar ɗalibai. Wannan zaɓe yana da muhimmanci sosai, domin shugabar ɗalibai tana da iko a makarantar. Ita ce take kai maganar ɗalibai wajen malamai.

A wannan shekara, 'yan mata biyu sun tsaya takara: Rashida da Kaltume. Akwai wani kwamitin malamai uku da yake shirya zaɓen. Shugaban kwamitin shi ne Malam Bala.

Malam Bala ya ce wa ɗalibai, "Kowace 'yar makaranta za ta kaɗa ƙuri'a ɗaya. Zaɓi yana hannunku."

Rashida ta yi magana a gaban ɗalibai. "Idan kun zaɓe ni, zan kawo cigaba a makarantarmu," ta ce. "Za mu gyara ɗakin karatu."

Sannan Kaltume ta yi magana. "Ina son haɗin kai a tsakanin ɗalibai," ta ce. "Idan muna da haɗin kai, za mu samu cigaba. Kowace 'yar makaranta tana da muhimmanci."

Bayan haka, wata 'yar makaranta mai suna Lantana ta ce wa wata, "Wacce ce zaɓinki?"

"Kaltume ce zaɓina," ta ce. "Ina son haɗin kai."

Ranar zaɓe, kowace 'yar makaranta ta kaɗa ƙuri'arta. Bayan haka, kwamitin ya duba zaɓin ɗalibai.

Malam Bala ya tsaya a gaban ɗalibai. "Kwamiti ya gama aikinsa," ya ce. "Kaltume ce wacce ta yi nasara."

Ɗalibai da yawa sun yi farin ciki. Rashida ta je wajen Kaltume ta ce mata, "Ina tare da ke. Mu yi aiki tare domin cigaban makarantarmu."

Kaltume ta ce, "Na gode. Wannan shi ne haɗin kai." Yanzu Kaltume tana da iko a makarantar, amma tana yin kowane aiki tare da Rashida.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa zaɓen yake da muhimmanci?
Domin shugabar ɗalibai tana da iko a makarantar.
Su wa suka tsaya takara?
Rashida da Kaltume ne suka tsaya takara.
Wane ne shugaban kwamitin?
Malam Bala ne shugaban kwamitin.
Me Kaltume take so a tsakanin ɗalibai?
Tana son haɗin kai.
Wacce ce ta yi nasara?
Kaltume ce ta yi nasara.

lessons.title: Kasuwancin Hindatu
lessons.summary: When her husband loses his job in Gombe, Hindatu borrows from her father, starts a food business on her own, saves carefully and pays the debt back.
lessons.text:
Hindatu matar aure ce a Gombe. Ita da mijinta Mukhtar suna da yara huɗu. Mukhtar yana aiki a wani kamfani.

Wata rana, Mukhtar ya rasa aikinsa. Iyalinsu sun shiga wahala, domin babu kuɗi a gida.

Hindatu ta yi tunani sosai. Sannan ta yanke shawara ta fara kasuwanci da kanta. Ta ci bashin 50,000 daga wajen mahaifinta.

"Zan mayar maka da bashinka bayan wata shida," ta ce wa mahaifinta.

Da farko, Hindatu tana yin komai da kanta. Tana yin abinci, sannan tana kai shi kasuwa. Mutane da yawa suna son abincinta, kuma suna biyan ta da kyau.

Hindatu tana tattalin kuɗinta sosai. Ba ta kashe kuɗi a kan abubuwan da ba su da amfani ba. "Tattali yana da muhimmanci a kasuwanci," ta ce wa mijinta.

Mukhtar ma ya ba ta taimako. Kowace rana yana kai abincin kasuwa a motarsa. Da taimakon mijinta, kasuwancin Hindatu ya fara girma.

Bayan wata uku, Hindatu ta canza wurin kasuwancinta. Ta samu wani babban wuri kusa da wata makaranta, inda ɗalibai da malamai suke zuwa su ci abinci. Ta kuma canza abincinta: yanzu tana yin abinci iri uku.

Bayan wata shida, ta je wajen mahaifinta. Ta mayar masa da bashinsa dukka.

Mahaifinta ya yi farin ciki. "Kin yi aiki sosai," ya ce. "Iyalinki ba su rasa abinci ba."

Yanzu Mukhtar ba ya neman aiki a kamfani. Yana aiki tare da matarsa a kasuwancinta, kuma iyalinsu suna cikin farin ciki.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru da Mukhtar?
Ya rasa aikinsa.
Daga wajen wa Hindatu ta ci bashi?
Ta ci bashi daga wajen mahaifinta.
Me Hindatu take cewa game da tattali?
Tana cewa tattali yana da muhimmanci a kasuwanci.
Wane taimako Mukhtar ya ba ta?
Yana kai abincin kasuwa a motarsa.
Yaushe Hindatu ta mayar da bashin?
Ta mayar da bashin bayan wata shida.

lessons.title: A kotu
lessons.summary: Mamman, a court official in Bauchi, watches the court free Hashimu, who was accused of stealing a car, after a police photo shows the real thief.
lessons.text:
Mamman jami'in kotu ne a Bauchi. Aikinsa shi ne ya kira mutane su shiga kotu, kuma ya rubuta abin da ake faɗa a kotun.

Wata rana, wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya kawo wani mutum mai suna Hashimu kotu. Ana zargin Hashimu da sata. Wani mutum mai suna Barau ya ce an sace motarsa a kasuwa, kuma ya ga Hashimu kusa da motar.

Shugaban kotun ya ce wa Hashimu, "Ana zarginka da satar mota. Kai ne ka aikata wannan laifi?"

"Ban aikata ba," Hashimu ya ce. "Ba ni ne na sace motar ba."

Jami'in 'yan sandan ya ce, "Akwai wani hoto da muka samu a kasuwa. Hoton ya nuna lokacin da aka sace motar." Ya ba shugaban kotun hoton.

Shugaban kotun ya duba hoton. A cikin hoton akwai wani mutum daban, ba Hashimu ba. Sunan mutumin Habu.

'Yan sanda sun kira Habu, amma ya ƙi zuwa kotu. Sai jami'in 'yan sanda ya je ya kama shi, ya kawo shi kotu.

Shugaban kotun ya ce wa Habu, "Ƙin zuwa kotu ma laifi ne. Bin doka yana da muhimmanci ga kowa."

Habu ya ce, "Ni ne na aikata satar. Na sace motar."

Sai shugaban kotun ya yanke hukunci. "Hashimu ba shi da laifi," ya ce. "Habu zai mayar wa Barau da motarsa. Hukuncinsa kuma shi ne zai yi shekara ɗaya a gidan yari, domin sata da ƙin bin doka."

Mamman ya rubuta lamarin a littafin kotu. Lamarin ya ba shi mamaki, amma ya yi farin ciki da cewa kotu ta gano gaskiya.

Tambayoyi:
Mamman yana aiki a ina?
Yana aiki a kotu a Bauchi.
Da me ake zargin Hashimu?
Ana zarginsa da satar mota.
Me hoton ya nuna?
Ya nuna wani mutum daban, Habu.
Me Habu ya ƙi yi?
Ya ƙi zuwa kotu.
Wane hukunci shugaban kotun ya yanke wa Habu?
Zai mayar da motar, kuma zai yi shekara ɗaya a gidan yari.

lessons.title: Ranar 'yancin kai
lessons.summary: On Independence Day at a school in Kaduna, Zuwaira's grandfather tells the pupils about 1960, and her dance group wins a prize although her partner steps on her foot.
lessons.text:
Zuwaira 'yar makaranta ce a Kaduna. Ranar 1 ga Oktoba ita ce ranar 'yancin kai a Najeriya. A wannan rana, kowace makaranta tana yin biki.

A ranar, Zuwaira da sauran ɗalibai sun haɗu a babban filin makaranta. Suka tsaya a tsakiyar filin. Suna tsaye, sai suka yi waƙar ƙasa.

Kakan Zuwaira ma ya zo bikin. Shi tsoho ne. Malamai sun ce masa ya ba ɗalibai labari.

Kakan ya tsaya a gaban ɗalibai. "A shekarar 1960, ina tsaye a tsakiyar wani babban fili a Kaduna," ya ce. "Mutane daga ƙabilu da yawa sun haɗu a wurin. A wannan rana ne Najeriya ta samu 'yancinta. Jarumai da yawa sun yi aiki domin wannan 'yanci."

Sannan ya ce, "Ku ma za ku iya zama jarumai idan kuna aiki domin ƙasarku."

Bayan haka, ƙungiyoyin ɗalibai suka yi rawa. Kowace ƙungiya ta yi rawar wata ƙabila. Zuwaira tana cikin ƙungiyar da take rawar Hausawa.

Wani yaro mai suna Danladi yana rawa tare da ita. Sau biyu ya taka ƙafarta!

"Kar ka sake taka ƙafata!" Zuwaira ta ce masa.

"Ba zan sake ba," Danladi ya ce. Daga nan, bai sake taka ƙafarta ba, kuma rawarsu ta yi kyau sosai.

A ƙarshe, malamai sun ba ƙungiyar Zuwaira kyauta, domin rawarsu ta fi ta kowa kyau. Kyautar littattafai ce.

Zuwaira ta kai kyautar wajen kakanta. Kakanta ya yi farin ciki. "Kin ga?" ya ce. "Ƙabilu da yawa, ƙasa ɗaya."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe ne ranar 'yancin kai a Najeriya?
Ranar 1 ga Oktoba ce.
Ina ɗalibai suka tsaya?
Sun tsaya a tsakiyar filin makaranta.
Me kakan Zuwaira ya ce game da shekarar 1960?
Ya ce mutane daga ƙabilu da yawa sun haɗu, kuma Najeriya ta samu 'yancinta.
Me Danladi ya yi sau biyu?
Ya taka ƙafar Zuwaira.
Wace kyauta ƙungiyar Zuwaira ta samu?
Ta samu kyautar littattafai.

lessons.title: Isiyaku a kogi
lessons.summary: Isiyaku carries people across a river in Niger in his boat; a strong wind rises on the way back, but he remembers his father's advice and keeps clear of the rocks.
lessons.text:
Isiyaku yana zaune a wani ƙaramin gari kusa da Kogin Kwara a Nijar. Yana da jirgin ruwa. Aikinsa shi ne ya kai mutane zuwa ɗaya ɓangaren kogin. A wancan ɓangaren akwai babban daji, kuma mutanen garin suna zuwa daji domin aiki.

Mahaifin Isiyaku ya taɓa gaya masa, "Kogi yana da kyau, amma yana da haɗari. A tsakiyar kogin akwai manyan duwatsu. Idan iska tana da ƙarfi, kada ka shiga ruwa."

Wata rana, wani mutum ya zo wajen Isiyaku. "Wai iska mai ƙarfi za ta zo yau," ya ce.

A ranar, wasu mata uku suna so su je daji. A lokacin babu iska, sai Isiyaku ya kai su ɗaya ɓangaren kogin. Suka fita daga jirgin, suka shiga daji.

Da Isiyaku yake kan hanya zuwa gida, sai iska ta fara. Iskar tana da ƙarfi sosai, kuma ruwan kogin ya tashi. Jirgin ya kusa ya taɓa wani babban dutse. Isiyaku ya ji tsoro, amma ya yi tunanin maganar mahaifinsa. Ya bi hanyar da babu duwatsu, sai ya isa gida lafiya.

Bayan wani lokaci, iskar ta ƙare. Sai Isiyaku ya koma daji, ya ɗauki matan uku, ya kawo su gida.

Da aikin ranar ya ƙare, ya zauna tare da mahaifinsa. "Na ga haɗari a yau," ya ce. "Amma na bi maganarka."

Mahaifinsa ya ce, "Ka sani? Wannan kogi yana tafiya har zuwa teku. Wai teku ya fi kogi girma sosai."

"Ina so in ga teku wata rana," Isiyaku ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Isiyaku yana zaune a ina?
Yana zaune a wani ƙaramin gari kusa da Kogin Kwara a Nijar.
Me akwai a ɗaya ɓangaren kogin?
Akwai babban daji.
Me mahaifinsa ya ce game da iska?
Ya ce idan iska tana da ƙarfi, kada ya shiga ruwa.
Me Isiyaku ya yi da iska ta fara?
Ya bi hanyar da babu duwatsu, sai ya isa gida lafiya.
Me Isiyaku yake so ya gani wata rana?
Yana so ya ga teku.

lessons.title: Marubuciya Sa'adatu
lessons.summary: Sa'adatu leaves her company job in Kano to write; her simple newspaper story about children working in the market instead of going to school moves the governor to act.
lessons.text:
Sa'adatu ta yi aiki a wani kamfani a Kano har shekara goma. Amma tun tana ƙarama, tana son rubutu. Kowace rana bayan aiki, tana rubuta labarai a cikin wani littafi. Abin da take so shi ne kasancewa marubuciya.

Wata rana ta yanke shawara. Ta daina aiki a kamfanin. Maimakon aikin kamfani, ta fara rubutu kullum.

Mahaifiyarta ta ce, "Me ya sa kika daina aikinki? Rubutu ba aiki ba ne!"

"Rubutu aiki ne," Sa'adatu ta ce. "Marubuci yana gaya wa mutane abubuwan da suke faruwa a rayuwarsu."

A garinsu, akwai wani al'amari da yake faruwa: yara da yawa suna aiki a kasuwa maimakon su je makaranta. Sa'adatu ta rubuta labari game da wannan al'amari.

Ta yi amfani da kalmomi masu sauƙi, domin kowa ya fahimta. Kowace kalma tana da muhimmanci a rubutunta. Sannan wata jarida ta buga labarin.

Labarin ya yi tasiri sosai. Mutane da yawa sun karanta shi. Gwamnan jihar ma ya karanta shi. Ya ce, "Wannan al'amari yana da muhimmanci." Gwamnati ta fara taimaka wa yaran su koma makaranta, maimakon su yi aiki a kasuwa.

Mahaifiyar Sa'adatu ta ga abin da ya faru. "Rubutu aiki ne kenan!" ta ce. "Kalmominki suna da tasiri."

"Shi kenan," Sa'adatu ta ce. "Wannan ne aikin marubuci."

Yanzu Sa'adatu ba ta yin aiki a kamfani. Kasancewarta marubuciya, kullum tana rubutu game da abubuwan da suke faruwa a garinsu.

Tambayoyi:
Sa'adatu ta yi aiki a ina?
Ta yi aiki a wani kamfani a Kano.
Me ya sa ta daina aiki a kamfanin?
Domin tana son kasancewa marubuciya.
Wane al'amari ne yake faruwa a garinsu?
Yara da yawa suna aiki a kasuwa maimakon su je makaranta.
Wace irin kalmomi ta yi amfani da su?
Ta yi amfani da kalmomi masu sauƙi.
Wane tasiri labarin ya yi?
Gwamnati ta fara taimaka wa yaran su koma makaranta.

lessons.title: Salihu a gidan tarihi
lessons.summary: Salihu, a guide at a museum in Kano, is appointed head of its staff, and he tells a group of pupils how the old kingdom of Kano closed its gates at night against attacks.
lessons.text:
Salihu yana aiki a wani gidan tarihi a Kano. Ya yi shekara shida a wurin, kuma ya saba da aikin sosai. Kowace rana yana nuna wa baƙi kayan tarihi, kuma yana ba su labarin Daular Kano.

Wata rana, shugaban gidan tarihin ya kira shi a waya. "Salihu, kwamitinmu ya amince za mu naɗa ka shugaban ma'aikatan gidan tarihin," ya ce. "Ka amince?"

"Na amince," Salihu ya ce. Ya yi farin ciki sosai. Bayan haka, ya kira matarsa a waya ya gaya mata labarin.

Bayan an naɗa shi, sai wasu 'yan makaranta goma suka zo gidan tarihin tare da malaminsu. Salihu ya nuna musu hoton ɗaya daga cikin ƙofofin birnin Kano.

"A da, Kano daula ce mai ƙarfi," ya ce musu. "Wasu sarakuna daga wasu dauloli sun sha kai wa Kano hari. Saboda haka mutanen Kano suka gina babbar ganuwa, kuma birnin yana cikinta. Kowane dare ana rufe ƙofofin birnin, domin kada wani ya kai hari da dare."

Wata 'yar makaranta wadda take tsaye a gaba ta ce, "Kano tana da ƙofofi nawa?"

"Tana da ƙofofi da yawa," Salihu ya ce. "Wasu daga cikinsu suna nan har yau."

'Yar makarantar wadda ta yi tambayar ta ji daɗi. Salihu ya ga farin ciki a fuskarta, da kuma a fuskokin sauran 'yan makarantar.

Da aikin rana ya ƙare, Salihu ya rufe ƙofar gidan tarihin, ya koma gida. Yanzu ya saba da sabon aikinsa ma.

Tambayoyi:
Salihu yana aiki a ina?
Yana aiki a wani gidan tarihi a Kano.
Wa ya kira Salihu a waya?
